liebermann.notes: Henry of Huntingdon (15th c.), followed by Latin hexameters on the English kings from Alfred to Henry III, Genealogia Normannica, English history to the capture of Hubert de Burgh [1232], then from the Tripartita Wl art (f. 123) and ECf retr with rubric list (f. 123v); after f. 128v (blank) another hand. Most closely related to Ra.

entries.text_de:
London Gray's Inn 9, Huntingdon 15. Jhs., dahinter f. 119 Hexameter über die Englischen Könige Alfred bis Heinrich III.; f. 120 Geneal. Normannica, Rollo bis zu Heinrich's III Kindern; f. 120v. Englische Geschichte bis zur Gefangennahme Hubert's de Burgh [1232]; f. 123 aus Tripartita: Wl art, u. S. 486; f. 123v. ECf retr9, u. S. 627, mit Rubrikenliste u. S. 670.

f. 128v. leer, Ende eines Theiles, dann andere Hand. Die Hs. ist nächst verwandt mit Ra.
entries.text_en:
London, Gray's Inn 9, Huntingdon, 15th century; after it, f. 119, hexameters on the English kings from Alfred to Henry III; f. 120 Geneal. Normannica, Rollo down to the children of Henry III; f. 120v. English history down to the capture of Hubert de Burgh [1232]; f. 123 from Tripartita: Wl art, below, p. 486; f. 123v. ECf retr9, below, p. 627, with list of rubrics, below, p. 670.

f. 128v. blank, end of a part, then another hand. The MS is most closely related to Ra.

transcription.doubts: Gr runs from foot of col. 1 to top of col. 2, p. xxvi. 'Gray's Inn' letter-spaced for justification only.
